mechanism_description: Independent public status plane with synthetic /health monitors, multi-product components, Slack, and third-party dependency visibility — using known OSS/status patterns, not a novel algorithm.
rework_cost_estimate: Wrong OSS pick costs days–weeks of ops/rehost, not multi-month R&D; preflight budget for arXiv literature not justified.
phase_b_reason: gate != novel_research_required; operator instructed Phase B DO NOT run — gate only
rationale: Credible free/OSS comparables (Upptime, Uptime Kuma, Statusnook, OpenStatus, Gatus) cover monitors, Slack, multi-endpoint status, and independent hosting. Operator forbids paid Statuspage. Work is integration/extension (DNS, component taxonomy, hosting isolation, AgePass /health as probe), not greenfield research.
open_decisions: Primary stack: Uptime Kuma (VPS, default) vs Upptime (GitHub) vs Statusnook (e-mail subscribers)
Where to host if not GitHub Pages (must not share AgePass Function App / RG)
Auto-red components on monitor fail vs human confirm before public Major
Third-party deps (Vipps, Quickbutik, Azure platform) as components vs incident text only
TEST environment visibility on public status.devora.no
Legacy status.agepass.* redirect vs deep-link notice
